Jo hansne se dar ko jeet le, wahi sahaswala hai.
Khamoshi wahi hai jahan strength accumulate hoti.
Chuppi se sach bahar aata hai.
Aasan zindagi ki dua mat karo, mushkil zindagi ko jhelne ki taqat ki dua karo.
Shahbaloot ka ped hawa se lada aur toot gaya, beed ka ped jhuka aur bach gaya.
Kabhi kabhi silence sabse best answer hota hai.
Toofan ka saamna karo.
Main nakam nahi hua, bas 10,000 tareeke dhoond liye jo kaam nahi aaye.
Grit dil ki lagan aur jidd hai.
Mind empty, formless, shapeless—jaise paani.
Strength hidden places mein grow hoti.
Chuppi mann ka mandir hai.
Silence sabse powerful scream hai.
Grit long run se mohabbat hai.
Sahanashilta mahan hoti hai.
Bahadur hona: afraid hoke bhi move.
Grit—hard cheezon ke liye long-term commitment.
Khamoshi dimag ka shor saaf karti.
Zubaan talwar hai; khamoshi uska sheath.
Aantarik shaanti se badi koi taakat nahi hoti.
